description:
Modelled flood overlays within 1 km. Read `on_property` — a returned row
means "found nearby", not "this property floods".

**Price: 10¢ per call.**

geojson.description: When true, add a `geojson` FeatureCollection of the hazard polygons clipped to a 1km-radius circle around the property, plus `geojson_meta` (default false — response unchanged).
